title: GTA 6: The Album Releases This November, And The First Six Songs Are Now Streaming From It
summary: "A collection of 34 brand-new, original tracks from a genre-defying roster"
text: GTA 6: The Album Releases This November, And The First Six Songs Are Now Streaming From It | Pure Xbox Menu Search Share Guest Guest Login | Sign Up Pure Xbox News Reviews Features Games Guides Videos Forums Search Keywords Guest Login or Sign Up Home Choose Topics... Manage Topics News Xbox GTA 6 The Album Grand Theft Auto IV GTA 6: The Album Releases This November, And The First Six Songs Are Now Streaming From It "A collection of 34 brand-new, original tracks from a genre-defying roster" by Fraser Gilbert 7 hours ago Share: Music is obviously a massive part of the Grand Theft Auto series, and Rockstar is taking things one step further with GTA 6 by releasing a special album with 34 "brand-new, original" songs that have been curated for the soundtrack. The first six of those songs have been unveiled today, featuring artists including Yung Lean, Travis Scott, Morgan Wallen and Keith Richards. Each song is slowly becoming available to stream online across multiple platforms. Here's what we received about this in an official press release: "Grand Theft Auto VI: The Album, a collection of 34 brand-new, original tracks from a genre-defying roster of the most exciting artists in the world, is available for pre-save now on all major music streaming services here ." Yung Lean - That's It (feat. Future & Metro Boomin) Travis Scott - RHYNO (prod. by Guy-Manuel de Homem-Christo) CA7RIEL & Paco Amoroso, PinkPantheress, Fred again.. & Etienne de Crécy - Sexy Magic Morgan Wallen - Last Thing You Need Rauw Alejandro - Macacoa 2000 Keith Richards - Bright Lights, Big City Rockstar even has a dedicated website for this album where you can pre-order it in various forms, including CD and Vinyl. The CD version is only £10.99 / $19.98, so you won't be paying an absolute fortune to pick it up.
